svg.title: MirbadLLM deployment topologies
svg.desc: On one machine the master and agent run as two containers and the agent starts one container per model; in a multinode setup the master runs on one host and dials an agent on each Linux, Windows or macOS node over mTLS on port 9443, and each node enrolls once on port 8443.
svg.text: Linux GPU host (for example a DGX Spark)
one container per running model; the agent
starts them and adopts them after a restart
